title: Why Trust—and Not Just Tactics—Will Make or Break Your Business Deal
description:
If you’re buying or selling a small business, you’re already thinking about numbers, legal terms, and closing dates. But what about trust, conflict, and how not to completely blow up the deal over something emotional?

In this episode of the DealMakers Podcast, I’m joined by Dana Garnett—a conflict strategy coach and mediator who helps business owners navigate the messiest part of M&A: human emotions. We talk about the overlooked but critical skill of building trust early, why most deals don’t die over dollars but over feelings, and how “radical empathy” (yes, really) can actually save you time, money, and cortisol.

We cover:

➡️ What to do when your seller’s spouse is secretly doing all the bookkeeping
➡️ Why buyers often come across as interrogators instead of allies
➡️ Real examples of trust breakdowns that killed deals
➡️ How to talk to someone you’re pretty sure is about to sue you
➡️ And yes—how family dynamics sneak into almost every “small business” sale

Whether you’re a first-time buyer, seasoned entrepreneur, or deal attorney (hi friends), this is one of those episodes that’ll shift how you think about negotiation and conflict for good.

Learn more about Dana at https://www.mindfulstrategy.com
